The state’s interest is best described as a fee simple subject to a condition subsequent, because the grant creates a present fee simple estate that may be cut short by the grantor’s exercise of a right of re-entry upon the occurrence of the stated condition. The note’s suggestion that the estate ends automatically is incorrect; the language “may re-enter” indicates the grantor must take affirmative action to reclaim the land.  
CONFIDENCE: 95
